Its major characteristic is social responsibility — promoting public good, accountability, fairness, justice, equity. Political gerrymandering (A) is manipulation of boundaries. Corporate responsibility (C) is business ethics. Desire to win election (D) is political ambition.

body.text: Citizenship is acquired through: birth (by descent/place), naturalization (legal process), honorary (honorary grant), registration (marriage/ancestry).

text.text: Human Rights are basic natural rights which people enjoy primarily because they are

key_point.text: Human rights are inherent to all human beings, not dependent on status

body.text: Human rights are universal and inherent to human dignity - they exist because you are a human being, not because of community membership, citizenship, or party affiliation.

trap.text: A/C/D tie rights to status (community, international, party). Rights exist regardless.

text.text: Commerce started as a result of

key_point.text: Commerce arose from specialization — people exchange what they produce for what they need

body.text: Commerce is the exchange of goods and services. It started when people specialized in producing specific goods (division of labour) and needed to trade their surplus for other goods they couldn't produce. Specialization (C) creates interdependence, which necessitates commerce. Competition (A), privatization (B), and distribution (D) are later developments.

trap.text: Competition, privatization, distribution are features of developed markets, not the origin of commerce.

text.text: The process of changing raw materials into finished goods is

key_point.text: Manufacturing = converting raw materials into finished goods

body.text: Manufacturing is the production process that transforms raw materials (e.g., cotton, steel, crude oil) into finished goods (e.g., cloth, cars, petrol). Extraction (B) obtains raw materials. Construction (D) builds infrastructure. Marketing (A) promotes/sells goods.

trap.text: Extraction obtains raw materials; construction builds structures; marketing sells. Only manufacturing transforms materials into finished products.

text.text: An example of a primary product is

key_point.text: Primary products = raw materials from nature (agriculture/mining); palm oil is a classic WAEC example

body.text: Primary products are raw materials extracted directly from nature (agriculture, mining, forestry, fishing). Palm oil is an agricultural primary product — extracted from palm fruit. Cocoa (A) is also primary, but palm oil is the classic WAEC textbook example. Textile (B) and flour (D) are processed/manufactured goods.

trap.text: Cocoa is also primary, but palm oil is the standard WAEC example. Textile and flour are manufactured/processed.

text.text: All activities geared towards the distribution and exchange of goods and services is

key_point.text: Commerce = all activities in distribution/exchange of goods and services

body.text: Commerce = all activities involved in distribution and exchange of goods/services. Trade (B) = buying/selling. Personal selling (A) = one activity. Market survey (C) = research.

trap.text: A/B/C = components of commerce. D = comprehensive definition.

text.text: The word "limited" written after the name of a company means that
members are liable to the extent of their shareholdings only
the company is a going concern
it has a democratic system of management

key_point.text: Ltd = limited liability = members liable only to extent of shareholdings

body.text: "Limited" (Ltd) = limited liability company. Members' liability limited to amount unpaid on their shares. Not profit (A), going concern (C), or democracy (D).

trap.text: A = management decision. C = accounting assumption. D = governance. B = legal liability definition.

text.text: Which type of occupation is a carpenter engaged in?

key_point.text: Carpenter = builds/constructs = construction industry

body.text: Carpentry = building/construction work (woodwork, framing, finishing). Construction (B). Commercial (A) = trading. Extraction (C) = mining/quarrying. Manufacturing (D) = factory production.

trap.text: A = trading. C = mining/oil. D = factory. B = building/construction.

text.text: The reward for land as a factor of production is

key_point.text: Land = rent; Labour = wages; Capital = interest; Entrepreneurship = profit

body.text: Factor rewards: Land → rent, Labour → wages, Capital → interest, Entrepreneurship → profit. Land reward = rent (C).

trap.text: A (interest) = capital. B (profit) = entrepreneurship. D (wage) = labour.

text.text: Which of the following businesses can raise capital through the stock exchange?

key_point.text: Public company (PLC) = can sell shares on stock exchange

body.text: Public limited company (PLC) can offer shares to public via stock exchange. Sole proprietorship (A), private company (B), cooperative (C) cannot.

trap.text: A/B/C = private/unlisted. D = public = listed on stock exchange.

text.text: A group of people representing a cross-section of business interests in an area is

key_point.text: Chamber of commerce = cross-section of business interests in area

body.text: Chamber of Commerce = association representing cross-section of businesses in area (retail, wholesale, services, etc.). Employers' assoc (A) = employers only. Manufacturers' (C) = manufacturers only. Consumers' (D) = consumers.

trap.text: A/C/D = specific groups. B = cross-section (all business types).

text.text: One of the disadvantages of selling on credit is

key_point.text: Credit sales → risk of bad debts (customers don't pay)

body.text: Selling on credit: customers may default = bad debts (unrecoverable). Liquidity (B) = decreases (cash tied up). Profit (C) = may increase (more sales). Turnover (D) = may increase (credit sales).

trap.text: B/C/D = opposite or neutral. A = direct risk.

text.text: A number of shops under one roof is a

key_point.text: Discount store = multiple shops under one roof, self-service, discount prices

body.text: Discount store = multiple shops/outlets under one roof, self-service, discounted prices. Chain store (B) = multiple locations. Unit store (C) = single small. Department store (D) = departments in one building.

trap.text: B (chain) = multiple locations. C (unit) = single. D (department) = departments in one building.

text.text: An organization of producers of similar products, which controls output with the intention to fix price is

key_point.text: Cartel = producers collude to fix prices/output

body.text: Cartel = agreement among producers to restrict output, fix prices, divide markets. Syndicate (A) = share profits/losses. Trust (C) = merged under single control. Consortium (D) = temporary project alliance.

trap.text: A = profit sharing. C = merger. D = project-based. B = price/output control.

text.text: One of the functions of a trade association is to

key_point.text: Trade association = promotes members' welfare (training, lobbying, standards)

body.text: Trade associations = promote members' welfare (training, lobbying, standards, networking). A = government. B = employer duty. D = individual firms.

trap.text: A/B/D = government/employer/individual. C = association's core function.

text.text: The practice of selling goods to a foreign country at lower prices than obtainable in the exporting country is

key_point.text: Dumping = selling abroad below domestic price/cost

body.text: Dumping = exporting goods at price below domestic price or cost of production. Hedging (B) = risk management. Speculation (C) = profit from price changes. Skimming (D) = high initial price.

trap.text: B = risk management. C = profit from price changes. D = pricing strategy.

text.text: A foreign order which instructs an agent to buy certain goods from a particular supplier is

key_point.text: Closed indent = specifies exact supplier; open indent = agent chooses

body.text: Closed indent = buyer specifies exact supplier. Open indent (A) = agent chooses supplier. Letter of credit (B) = payment. Letter of enquiry (C) = information request.

trap.text: A = agent chooses. B = payment. C = inquiry. D = specified supplier.

text.text: Which of the following is not a condition for dissolution of a partnership?

key_point.text: Partnership dissolves: venture end, mutual consent, disagreement; NOT annual expiry

body.text: Partnership dissolves: (A) venture ends, (B) mutual agreement, (C) disagreement/illegal acts, death, bankruptcy. Expiration of business year (D) = accounting period, not dissolution.

trap.text: A/B/C = valid dissolution causes. D = accounting period, not dissolution.

import volume is greater than export
import and export volumes are equal
export volume is greater than imports

body.text: Balance of trade = Exports - Imports. Negative (-$20M) = imports exceed exports. A = imports > exports. B = zero balance. C = exports > imports. D = composition, not balance.

trap.text: B = zero. C = positive. D = composition, not balance.

text.text: The collection of import duty is a function of the

key_point.text: Re-insurance = insurers share risk with other insurers

trap.text: A = premium sharing. B = insufficient cover. D = risk assessment. C = risk sharing.

enforcing law and order in harbors

trap.text: B/C/D = payable without acceptance. A = requires acceptance to be binding.

key_point.text: Central Bank sells securities → withdraws money from circulation → reduces cash in economy

text.text: The amount a current holder is allowed to withdraw in excess of the balance in his account is

key_point.text: Overdraft = withdrawal beyond account balance (short-term credit)

trap.text: A = transfer. C = cost. D = regular payment. B = overdraft definition.

text.text: Which of the following business risks would an insurance firm not cover for an entrepreneur?

trap.text: A/C/D = pure risks (insurable). B = business risk (uninsurable).

text.text: In departmental accounts, administrative expenses are recorded in the

key_point.text: Admin expenses = overheads → P&L account (not trading or appropriation)

body.text: Administrative expenses are indirect overheads (salaries, rent, office expenses). They are charged to the Profit & Loss Account (income statement). Trading account = direct costs. Balance sheet = assets/liabilities. Appropriation = profit distribution.
